_source: Copied once from prototype/data/{icons,tools}.json and DESIGN-SPEC.md §10 (UI round 2 S2, 27 Sept 2026). The drawings are prototype/icons/<id>.svg, final and green (python icons/_check.py PASS). Edit the drawings in the prototype, re-copy, then re-run tools/build-ui-icons.mjs; this file is not itself re-derived from prototype/ at build time (D2: no product tool reads work/).
_fields: id; kind (tool|session|ui|status|purpose|export|tag); meaning (one line: what the drawing shows and what it means); mirror_rtl (true = flip with scaleX(-1) under dir=rtl); why_mirror (only when the answer is not obvious); fill (outline|filled|mixed: which parts are filled, see §10 fill policy); sizes (px it must hold at); alias_of (same drawing, second id: draw once); kind also shape|event (S11a)

icons.meaning: Photograph the page: four viewfinder corners around a nuqta, the frame closing on the page.
Record the screen: a screen outline with a filled round record dot (a circle, not a nuqta) in its middle and a short stand.
Check another size: a laptop outline with a phone outline overlapping its inline-end corner.
Mask real data: two text lines, the middle one covered by a solid 3px bar.
Check accessibility: the accessibility figure (head as a nuqta, open arms, legs) inside an open ring like the mark's.
Check page speed: a three-quarter gauge (y 4-18) with a needle and a nuqta at its pivot.
Check the links: two interlocked rounded chain links at 45 degrees.
Measure code coverage: angle brackets over a progress bar that is two-thirds filled. Coverage fill is a 2px bar inside the track (fill budget).
icons.why_mirror: code brackets read left to right in both languages

icons.meaning: Check the fine print: a document corner with three short lines and a small magnifier over the bottom line.
Design the values: an input field split into three ranges by two ticks, a nuqta sitting in the middle range.
Try nasty values: an input field open at its inline-end, a text cursor, and a zigzag breaking out of the field.
icons.why_mirror: the zigzag follows the text cursor, which moves in the reading direction

icons.meaning: Fill the form: two stacked fields, the first holding a 2px value bar at its inline-start.
icons.why_mirror: value bars start at the inline-start edge of a field

icons.meaning: Harvest the page: a page with three nuqtas on it, their lines gathering into one list mark at the inline-end.
icons.why_mirror: the gathering runs toward the inline-end

icons.meaning: Copy a locator: an open crosshair ring with four short ticks and a nuqta at the centre.
Draw the flow: three rounded nodes joined by lines, the middle one a diamond.
icons.why_mirror: the flow runs in the reading direction

icons.meaning: Reverse-engineer the spec: an open book, one line on each page (the bilingual draft).
Send a request: curly braces with a short arrow leaving them to the right.
icons.why_mirror: braces are code and stay left to right

icons.meaning: Break a request: a connection line from a nuqta, broken by a diagonal jog across the full width.
Stress the layout: three text lines aligned to the right, the longest overrunning a frame edge.
icons.why_mirror: it depicts right-to-left itself; mirroring would invert its meaning

icons.meaning: Start a session recording: an open ring (the mark's ring gap) around a filled round dot (a circle: the record dot is the one round dot in the set).
Stop the session: a filled rounded square, corner radius 2.
Pause a screen recording: two filled rounded bars.
Quick action Screenshot: same drawing as tool-shot.
Quick action Copy a locator: same drawing as tool-pick.
Add note: a square note with its bottom inline-end corner folded and two short lines.
icons.why_mirror: the fold sits at the inline-end corner, the lines start inline-start

icons.meaning: Copy / copy again: two overlapping rounded rectangles, the front one offset toward the bottom inline-end.
Done, copied, selected: a single tick. Drawn, never typed (Thmanyah has no tick glyph).
A failed item mark in lists: a small x, heavier than close.
Close a menu, sheet or tool detail: a light x in the live area.
Back to All tools in the narrow sheet: an arrow pointing to the inline-start.
Disclosure / menu opens below / sheet expands.
A row that opens something further along the reading direction.
Add a tool to Favourites: a five-point star with rounded joins, outline.
The tool is in Favourites: the same star, filled with currentColor (ochre).
The more menu: three nuqtas in a row (Thmanyah has no ellipsis-midline glyph).
Settings: three horizontal slider lines, each with a nuqta knob at a different position.
Dock to the side: a window outline whose right column is a filled panel.
icons.why_mirror: Chrome puts the side panel where its own setting says, not where the UI language reads

icons.meaning: Open QA Wrap (from the in-page bar): a small window with a title bar and a nuqta in it.
Theme follows the machine: a circle half filled (the fill on the inline-end half).
Light theme: a small circle with eight nuqtas around it as rays.
Night theme: a crescent opening toward the top right.
Language: a stroke-drawn Latin A beside a stroke-drawn Arabic ba with its diamond nuqta below (drawn paths, not type).
icons.why_mirror: it shows both scripts in fixed places

icons.meaning: Drag handle of the in-page bar: six nuqtas in two columns of three.
Shrink the bar to a pill: two short diagonal arrows pointing inward to the centre.
Keep the in-page bar solid: a push-pin, flat cap, tapered body and needle; pressed means the bar never fades.
Show the bar again: two short diagonal arrows pointing outward.
Opens in a new tab (Open the report, Timeline, Tutorials): an arrow leaving a rounded box toward the top inline-end.
Timeline: a horizontal line with three nuqta nodes, the last one ringed.
icons.why_mirror: time runs in the reading direction

icons.meaning: Tutorials: a rounded screen with a play triangle.
Report a problem (reporter mode): a flag on a pole.
Reload the extension: an open circular arrow, clockwise.
Awake: an open eye with a round pupil.
Asleep: a closed eye, a downward curve with three short lashes.
Not a web page / not allowed here: a rounded lock.
Read the notice: a document with a tick at its lower inline-end corner.
Steps recorded: three short lines each led by a nuqta bullet at the inline-start.
Events count: a small pulse line with one peak.
Saved to downloads: an arrow down into an open tray.
PASS: a tick inside a circle. Colour --pass; the shape carries the meaning without colour.
FAIL: an x inside a circle. The only icon ever drawn in --fail (red).
Warning / blocked / restricted banner: a rounded triangle holding a short stroke over a nuqta (the exclamation, drawn).
SKIPPED: a circle with a short horizontal dash.
Information / what does this tool do: a circle holding a nuqta over a short stroke.
Pick purpose 1, Any: a nuqta inside a large rounded diamond (the nuqta, magnified), distinct from record (ring + round dot), shot (corners) and element (corner brackets).
Pick purpose 2, Step: three nuqtas joined by a line, ascending in the reading direction.
icons.why_mirror: a sequence runs in the reading direction

icons.meaning: Pick purpose 3, Element: four corner brackets around a small filled square (this thing must be accounted for).
Pick purpose 4, Sensitive: a rounded field holding three nuqtas (a value that is never written down).
Export Playwright: angle brackets with a nuqta between them (a test script).
Export Markdown: the Markdown mark, a landscape card holding an M and a down arrow.
Export JSON: a pair of curly braces around a nuqta.
Export the session sheet: a rounded table of three rows by two columns.
Open the report: a document with the external arrow leaving its top inline-end corner.
Note tag Bug: a filled rounded triangle (replaces the old text-drawn triangle; Thmanyah has no geometric-shape glyphs).
Note tag Issue: an outline rounded diamond.
Note tag Question: an outline circle.
Note tag Note: an outline rounded square.
Annotate Rectangle: a landscape box with square corners (only the round join softens them); drawn, never typed (Thmanyah has no ▭).
Annotate Rounded box: the shape-rect box with radius 5 corners, so the two read apart at 16.
Annotate Ellipse: a landscape oval on the shape-rect keyline.
Annotate Circle: a closed ring 18 across (no mark gap: the shape is the meaning).
Annotate Line: one diagonal stroke rising to the upper right, as drawn on the image (the shape, not a direction, so not mirrored).
Annotate Double arrow: a horizontal shaft with a head at both ends; symmetric, so never mirrored.
Annotate Triangle: the outline of warning without its mark, radius 2.5 corners.
Annotate Diamond: an outline diamond 18 across with radius 2 corners (tag-issue is the 16-across tag).
Annotate Star: same drawing as star.
Annotate Tick mark: same drawing as check (Thmanyah has no ✓).
Annotate Cross mark: same drawing as close, the 12-across x that matches the weight of the tick (Thmanyah has no ✗).
Annotate Question mark: a hook whose dot is the family nuqta, as Thmanyah dots its own marks.
Annotate Exclamation mark: an upright stroke over a nuqta.
Annotate Dot stamp: a ring around a 6-across nuqta (the dot is the subject, so it is drawn larger than the 4-across point-of-action nuqta).
Report timeline Action (a click or a keystroke): a pointer arrow. Cursors are not mirrored.
Report timeline Request: an up arrow and a down arrow, the request going out and the response coming back.
Report timeline Console: a terminal frame with a prompt chevron and a cursor bar; console output is left-to-right code, so never mirrored.
Report timeline Page (a navigation): an arrow to the inline-end, the mirror image of back.
A stored credential was used here: a key, bow at the lower start, two teeth.
An event of a kind with no drawing of its own: a lone 8-across nuqta (alone, so drawn at twice the point-of-action size to hold at 16).
Play a replay or a recording: a filled triangle, shifted toward its point for optical centre. Media transport, so filled and never mirrored.

_s11a: S11a (28 Sept 2026) drew shape-*, event-*, key, dot and play here directly (not copied from the prototype), to the DESIGN-SPEC §10 rules with the S2 drawings as the optical reference. stage2_map names the id that replaces each Stage-2 glyph (annotate SHAPES, the report sprite, replay, the DevTools panel); S11b applies it.
